Use case: text-localization / precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a correctly mirrored 1672×941 main-menu scene for «Дом пропавших дорог», with carved panel RIGHT and house/river/village LEFT. Its title is currently backward. Input 2 is ONLY a typography and carving reference showing the original correctly readable title; do not copy its left-panel composition or its buttons.
Change ONLY the three lines of title on the TOP OF THE RIGHT PANEL so they read normally left to right in Cyrillic:
Дом
пропавших
дорог
Use the exact same beautiful elongated carved old-Russian letterforms, warm pale wood/gold color, carved relief and shadows as the readable title in reference 2. Keep each line in the same area it occupies in target 1: Дом near x1340..1540 y60..170, пропавших near x1224..1540 y174..235, дорог near x1325..1540 y242..325. The lines are aligned toward the RIGHT to preserve the mirrored carved twig ornament at the lower LEFT of the title. Do not change the twig or horizontal carved ledge below the title. Do not mirror the readable letters.
Every pixel outside the title lettering area must remain as in target 1: carved frame, all dark blank wood below the title, plants, house, porch, river, village, sky, camera, color and lighting. No buttons, no signature, no additional text. Exact original 1672×941 canvas. This is a surgical title correction, NOT a new composition or redesign.

Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Create ONLY a transparent game pause panel asset for «Дом пропавших дорог», using the attached main menu as the precise MATERIAL, COLOR, CARVING and LETTERING reference. Do not include its scene, game title, options or signature.
Full PNG canvas 1672×941, true alpha transparency. The panel is a wide HORIZONTAL carved dark wooden board in the LOWER screen, approximately x236..1436, y640..920 (1200 px wide, 280 px tall). Keep the upper two thirds of the canvas completely transparent. No room or background. Outside the board transparent, with only a very soft short shadow immediately below it.
Use the same deep brown aged timber, vertical wood grain and rich traditional old-Russian leaf-and-geometric woodcarving as the attached menu frame. Slim carved edge bands; leaf carving at corners and geometric lower trim. Flat front-facing UI board, no skew or scene perspective. The dark timber center must remain legible and uncluttered, without modern buttons.
At top center of the board, carve and delicately gild the exact single word "Пауза" in the same elegant old-Russian-inspired letter family as the reference title. Approximate title band y660..706. The middle area below heading is completely BLANK dark wood, spacious for six game-drawn options in TWO HORIZONTAL ROWS; do not draw these options, any dividers or selection states.
Near bottom center, approximately y864..879, include one short restrained carved ornament, matching the reference. Below it leave a small clean dark-wood space for a future Esc line that will be drawn by the game. Do NOT write Esc or any footer text. The only text anywhere in this PNG is "Пауза". No linen, no towel, no parchment, no icons. Clear silhouette with natural anti-aliased alpha edges, no colored matte, no checkerboard baked in.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a transparent full-canvas PNG overlay, 1672×941, with just ONE small hand-scratched inscription in the bottom of a RIGHT-hand wooden menu panel. Everything except the letter cuts must be transparent, including letter counters. No actual wooden board or background.
Exact one-line text: "made by Yahor Zavatski, 2026". Spell: m-a-d-e [space] b-y [space] Y-a-h-o-r [space] Z-a-v-a-t-s-k-i, [space] 2-0-2-6.
Place the whole line approximately x1235..1560, y758..792. Visible letter height about 26–30 px, narrow enough to fit the entire phrase on one line. Larger and clearer than a tiny signature, but still modest relative to the 1672×941 canvas.
Draw each letter as SIMPLE HANDWRITTEN PRINT scratched stroke by stroke with a knife into old dark wood: thin irregular angular cuts, slightly differing heights, baseline and slants, occasional double scratches and worn interruptions. NO SERIFS, NO regular font outline, no calligraphy, no filled thick text. Brighter warm pale wood fibers inside the cuts, a tiny darker groove edge, good contrast and clear readability on dark brown timber. Not glowing or white neon, not gold embossed metal. It should feel like an old human inscription, not typeset text.
No rectangle, wood patch, woodgrain, icons, flourishes or any other words. Real alpha transparency everywhere outside the irregular letter incisions. Do not center or enlarge the inscription to fill the canvas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: inventory object sprite for a painterly Russian folk narrative game. Create one isolated cup WITH its matching saucer, transparent PNG, exact square canvas 512×512.
A beautiful old-fashioned white glazed ceramic tea cup with a graceful handle on the RIGHT, decorated with rich cobalt blue hand-painted floral folk ornament in the spirit of Gzhel: broad blue flower petals, curling leaves, fine blue rim accents. Matching shallow white-and-cobalt saucer directly beneath the cup. Slight handmade irregularities and subtle glaze texture, cared-for but not factory-perfect.
View from slightly ABOVE and from the FRONT LEFT at a three-quarter angle, so the empty pale interior and ellipse of rim are visible. Warm soft light from upper left, warm shadows, tactile painterly realism matching a richly illustrated old Russian wooden-house adventure game; realistic proportions, subtle brushwork, no cartoon outlines and no flat vector style.
The cup and saucer form ONE centered composition, filling most of the square (roughly 420–440 px width), with comfortable transparent margins and no cropping of handle or saucer. No table, no floor, no scene, no hands, no spoon, no tea, no steam, no words or labels. Outside the cup and saucer is genuine alpha transparency, including the gap inside the handle. Crisp clean anti-aliased cutout edges, no background-color fringe.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated WHITE ceramic CUP WITH SAUCER as a companion inventory sprite to the reference blue cup. Match the reference's painterly material realism, three-quarter view from slightly above/front left, warm upper-left illumination, scale and right-hand handle. This is a new red-decorated cup, not the blue design.
Square transparent PNG, target 512×512. Warm ivory-white glazed ceramic cup and matching saucer, old Russian folk character. Hand-painted NORTHERN RUSSIAN inspired ornament in muted brick red: a small stylized red horse and birds, fine linear geometric bands, rhythmic chevrons and tiny cross/diamond motifs, with a few fine dark-brown line accents. Evoke Mezen / Northern Dvina vernacular painting, adapted artistically to ceramics. The cup remains predominantly WHITE, with restrained red ornament rather than a solid red body. Simple graceful ceramic handle on RIGHT; matching saucer. No blue decoration.
Subtle handmade glaze and tiny age imperfections, no broken edges. Empty pale interior visible. Center the complete cup and saucer large on the square with generous transparent margins, no cropping, same angle as reference. True alpha transparency around the silhouette and through the handle. No tabletop, room, hands, spoon, tea, steam, text, logos, price label or extra objects. Do not bake in a checkerboard. Warm painterly realism for a folk narrative adventure game, not a flat vector icon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated large rustic BLUE CLAY MUG, transparent square PNG, target 512×512, for the same painterly Russian folk narrative game as the reference. Reference is ONLY for painterly rendering, warm light and viewing angle, NOT cup shape or white body.
A substantially larger and sturdier handmade earthenware mug with a tall generous cylindrical/slightly rounded body, thick rim and a broad practical handle on the RIGHT. Body glazed rich muted cobalt blue, with hand-painted old Russian folk floral and leaf ornament in warm ivory and softer blue tones. Small areas of natural terracotta visible at the foot and rim hint at actual clay. Glaze softly lustrous and uneven, subtle brushwork, tactile handmade character. A dark blue/cream glazed EMPTY interior visible from slightly above/front-left, same three-quarter view and warm soft upper-left light as the reference.
NO SAUCER. Not a delicate porcelain teacup, no pedestal foot, no lid. One single complete blue mug, centered prominently, occupying most of a 512×512 transparent square with enough margin around the entire handle and base. Rich painterly realism compatible with an illustrated old Russian wooden-house adventure game, no cartoon black outlines or flat vector treatment. No table, floor, room, hands, drink, steam, labels or other objects. Genuine transparent background and transparent gap inside the handle. Clean anti-aliased silhouette with no colored matte.
